sentences.en: It will cost thirty thousand yen at the lowest estimate.
sentences.zh: 最低估计会花费三万日元。

sentences.en: Please estimate your best price and the earliest delivery date.
sentences.zh: 请报出你最好的价格和最早的交货日期。

sentences.en: Their estimate of the cost was wide of the mark.
sentences.zh: 他们对成本的估计差得远了。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：est（存在）+im+ate（做）→对存在的东西做评价
